data.title: The photolyase/cryptochrome of Aspergillus nidulans senses oxidative stress and shuttles from nuclei to mitochondria
data.author: Alexander Landmark, Tim Rudolf, Kevin Hundshammer, Jasmin Böhm, Kai Leister, Sylvia Erhardt, Reinhard Fischer
data.summary: Abstract Cryptochromes are photoreceptors with functions in the entrainment of circadian clocks or as proposed magnetoreceptors in birds or as light-independent regulators of stress responses in plants. Here, we show that the fungal cryptochrome-like photolyase CryA from Aspergillus nidulans is induced by light and oxidative stress and establishes negative-feedback loops for light- and stress-activated genes. The negative-feedback loops depend on CryA interaction with phytochrome and the HOG (high osmolarity glycerol) pathway transcription factor AtfA in nuclei. CryA translocated in less than one minute from nuclei to mitochondria in the presence of hydrogen peroxide suggesting mitochondrial functions and possibly mitochondrial-nuclear communication. The shuttle to mitochondria depended on the N-terminal extension and a cysteine therein, which probably induces conformational changes of CryA upon oxidation. Therefore, we propose CryA as a sensor for oxidative stress. Such an N-terminal extension is also present in other photolyases and some cryptochromes, suggesting evolutionary conservation of the mechanism.
data.title_cn: 构巢曲霉的光裂合酶/隐色素感知氧化应激并从细胞核到线粒体穿梭
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 隐花色素是一种光感受器，具有调节生物钟的功能，或者作为鸟类的磁感受器，或者作为植物中与光无关的应激反应调节剂。在这里，我们证明来自构巢曲霉的真菌隐花色素样光裂合酶 CryA 是由光和氧化应激诱导的，并为光和应激激活基因建立负反馈环。负反馈环依赖于 CryA 与细胞核中光敏色素和 HOG（高渗透甘油）途径转录因子 AtfA 的相互作用。在过氧化氢存在的情况下，CryA 在不到一分钟的时间内从细胞核转移到线粒体，表明线粒体功能和可能的线粒体-核通讯。向线粒体的穿梭依赖于 N 末端延伸和其中的半胱氨酸，这可能在氧化时诱导 CryA 的构象变化。因此，我们建议 CryA 作为氧化应激的传感器。这种 N 末端延伸也存在于其他光裂合酶和一些隐花色素中，表明该机制的进化保守性。

data.title: Myoferlin is a component of late-stage vRNP trafficking vesicles for enveloped RNA viruses
data.author: Stefano Bonazza, Hannah L. Turkington, Swathi Sukumar, Emily Peate, Hannah L. Coutts, Joshua J. Montgomery, Courtney Hawthorn, Erin M. P. E. Getty, Olivier Touzelet, Judit Barabas, Ultan F. Power, David G. Courtney
data.summary: Abstract The Rab11 endosomal recycling pathway is exploited by important respiratory RNA viruses such as IAV and RSV, aiding viral egress from the apical surface of polarized epithelial cells. Late in infection, Rab11-containing vesicles specifically transport viral ribonucleoprotein (vRNP) complexes towards the cell surface before packaging and budding. Rather than employing traditional Rab11-positive recycling endosomes, virus-infected cells generate remodelled Rab11-containing vesicles, as observed during IAV infection. Besides Rab11, no other conserved host co-factors have been identified among these various vRNP trafficking vesicles. Here we discover and confirm myoferlin’s association with IAV vRNPs in the cytoplasm and colocalisation with Rab11 during late stages of infection. We also find that this role is conserved in late-stage vRNP trafficking of other viruses, including RSV and SeV. Myoferlin likely recruits the EHD family of proteins, which are involved in endosomal biogenesis, to these unique vRNP trafficking endosomes, highlighting myoferlin’s pivotal role in viral replication.
data.title_cn: Myoferlin 是包膜 RNA 病毒晚期 vRNP 运输囊泡的组成部分
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 Rab11 内体循环途径被 IAV 和 RSV 等重要的呼吸道 RNA 病毒利用，帮助病毒从极化上皮细胞的顶端表面流出。在感染后期，含有 Rab11 的囊泡在包装和出芽之前特异性地将病毒核糖核蛋白 (vRNP) 复合物运输到细胞表面。正如 IAV 感染期间所观察到的，病毒感染的细胞并没有采用传统的 Rab11 阳性回收内体，而是产生了重构的含有 Rab11 的囊泡。除了 Rab11 之外，在这些不同的 vRNP 运输囊泡中没有发现其他保守的宿主辅助因子。在这里，我们发现并确认了肌铁蛋白与细胞质中 IAV vRNP 的关联，以及在感染后期与 Rab11 的共定位。我们还发现，这一作用在其他病毒（包括 RSV 和 SeV）的后期 vRNP 运输中是保守的。 Myoferlin 可能将参与内体生物发生的 EHD 蛋白家族招募到这些独特的 vRNP 运输内体中，这凸显了 Myoferlin 在病毒复制中的关键作用。

data.title: Antiparallel stacking of Csu pili drives Acinetobacter baumannii 3D biofilm assembly
data.author: Henri Malmi, Natalia Pakharukova, Bindusmita Paul, Minna Tuittila, Irfan Ahmad, Stefan David Knight, Bernt Eric Uhlin, Debnath Ghosal, Anton V. Zavialov
data.summary: Abstract Many Gram-negative nosocomial pathogens rely on adhesive filaments, known as archaic chaperone-usher pili, to establish stress- and drug-resistant, multi-layered biofilms. Here, we uncover the mechanism by which these pili build three-dimensional (3D) biofilm architectures. In situ analyses of Acinetobacter baumannii biofilms using electron microscopy (EM) reveal an extensive network of ultrathin, flat stacks of archaic Csu pili interconnecting bacterial cells in 3D space. Cryo-EM structures of a single native pilus, pilus pairs, and two types of multi-pilus stacks show that the pili pack into antiparallel sheets, with their rods connected laterally by junctions at their zigzag corners. This antiparallel arrangement ensures that contacts form primarily between pili from interacting cells rather than pili from the same cell. With a remarkably short helical repeat, archaic chaperone-usher pili spontaneously establish a high density of junctions that determines the biofilm’s 3D architecture. Our findings may help develop new therapies against multidrug-resistant bacterial infections by targeting pilus-pilus interactions.
data.title_cn: Csu 菌毛的反平行堆积驱动鲍曼不动杆菌 3D 生物膜组装
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：许多革兰氏阴性医院病原体依靠粘附丝（称为古老伴侣引导菌毛）来建立抗应激和抗药性的多层生物膜。在这里，我们揭示了这些菌毛构建三维（3D）生物膜结构的机制。使用电子显微镜 (EM) 对鲍曼不动杆菌生物膜进行原位分析，揭示了在 3D 空间中互连细菌细胞的古老 Csu 菌毛的超薄、扁平堆叠的广泛网络。单个原生菌毛、菌毛对和两种类型的多菌毛堆叠的冷冻电镜结构表明，菌毛堆积成反平行片，其杆通过锯齿形角处的连接点横向连接。这种反平行排列确保接触主要在相互作用细胞的菌毛之间形成，而不是在同一细胞的菌毛之间形成。古老的伴侣引导菌毛具有非常短的螺旋重复，自发地建立高密度的连接，从而决定了生物膜的 3D 结构。我们的研究结果可能有助于通过针对菌毛-菌毛相互作用来开发针对多重耐药细菌感染的新疗法。

data.title: Evaluating the evolutionary relationship of TATA binding protein (TBP) with various folding patterns of protein domains using support vector machine (SVM)
data.author: Muthu Krishnan Selvaraj, Jasmeet Kaur
data.summary: This study focuses on the TATA-box binding, transcription initiation factor TFIID protein, (1tba) and employs a comprehensive approach combining structural, sequence and machine learning-based analysis to investigate its evolutionary relationships. By examining the TATA-box binding like protein, the study aims to identify similarities with other known protein folds, shedding light on its evolutionary relationship, and functional connections. To validate these relationships, a support vector machine (SVM) based algorithm was developed, which was complemented by another machine learning technique random forest, to ensure robust and reliable results. The integrated findings from structural, sequence, and machine learning analysis revealed several domain folds evolutionary related to TATA-box binding protein-like (1tba, B). The SVM-based method developed in this study serves as a valuable tool for identifying novel or functionally similar TATA-box binding proteins, providing deeper insights into their evolutionary and structural relationships. This work not only advances our understanding of the TATA-box binding protein family but also demonstrates the power of integrating computational and machine learning approaches in protein evolution research.
data.title_cn: 使用支持向量机 (SVM) 评估 TATA 结合蛋白 (TBP) 与蛋白质结构域的各种折叠模式的进化关系
data.abstract_cn: 本研究重点关注 TATA-box 结合转录起始因子 TFIID 蛋白 (1tba)，并采用结合结构、序列和基于机器学习的分析的综合方法来研究其进化关系。通过检查 TATA-box 结合蛋白，该研究旨在识别与其他已知蛋白质折叠的相似性，揭示其进化关系和功能联系。为了验证这些关系，开发了基于支持向量机 (SVM) 的算法，并辅以另一种机器学习技术随机森林，以确保结果稳健可靠。结构、序列和机器学习分析的综合结果揭示了几个与 TATA-box 结合蛋白样进化相关的结构域折叠 (1tba, B)。本研究中开发的基于 SVM 的方法可作为识别新型或功能相似的 TATA-box 结合蛋白的宝贵工具，从而更深入地了解其进化和结构关系。这项工作不仅增进了我们对 TATA-box 结合蛋白家族的理解，而且展示了在蛋白质进化研究中整合计算和机器学习方法的力量。

data.title: Orbital-resolved tuning of electronic thermal conductivity in monolayer h-B2O via doping in the diffusive regime
data.author: Farid Mohammadi, Kavoos Mirabbaszadeh, Houshyar Noshad
data.summary: The highly stable two-dimensional monolayer honeycomb borophene oxide (h-B2O) has attracted considerable interest due to its unique topological features and potential superconducting behavior. In this study, a tight-binding Hamiltonian is constructed by incorporating the Py and Pz orbitals of boron, effectively capturing the essential physics governing the material’s low-energy electronic behavior. Additionally, for the first time, the electronic thermal conductivity (ETC) of monolayer h-B2O is calculated using the Kubo-Greenwood formalism within the diffusive transport regime. The results reveal strong anisotropy ($$\:{\kappa\:}_{yy}\gg\:{\kappa\:}_{xx}$$), with room-temperature ETC values of $$\:5.9\times\:{10}^{-2}$$ mW m$$\:{}^{-1}$$ K$$\:{}^{-1}$$, 1 mW m$$\:{}^{-1}$$ K$$\:{}^{-1}$$, and 0.17 mW m$$\:{}^{-1}$$ K$$\:{}^{-1}$$along the armchair $$\:({\kappa\:}_{xx}$$), zigzag $$\:({\kappa\:}_{yy}$$), and anomalous Righi-Leduc effect $$\:({\kappa\:}_{xy}$$) directions, respectively. Furthermore, we systematically investigate the impact of impurity-induced disorder on ETC in h-B2O under both n-type and p-type doping, employing the T-matrix approximation. In the n-type regime, increasing impurity concentration $$\:{n}_{i}$$ = 2%, 4%, 6% leads to a significant enhancement of the ETC associated with the out-of-plane Pz orbital, attributed to its favorable spatial orientation and higher carrier occupancy. Conversely, the in-plane Py orbital exhibits a reduction in ETC due to increased localization and enhanced electron-electron scattering. Despite this orbital contrast, the total ETC rises along all crystallographic directions, governed by the dominant contribution of the Pz orbital, thereby revealing strong orbital-resolved behavior and pronounced directional anisotropy. In contrast, p-type doping induces only modest changes: the ETC contribution from the Py orbital slightly increases, while that of the Pz orbital is marginally reduced, resulting in an overall weak response of the total ETC. These findings highlight the crucial role of orbital symmetry, spatial orientation, and dopant type in shaping the anisotropic and tunable thermal transport properties of h-B2O. The thermal resilience under p-type doping, alongside the direction-dependent enhancement under n-type doping, positions h-B2O as a promising candidate for nanoscale thermoelectric and thermal management technologies.
data.title_cn: 通过扩散区掺杂对单层 h-B2O 中的电子热导率进行轨道分辨调节
data.abstract_cn: 高度稳定的二维单层蜂窝状硼吩氧化物（h-B2O）由于其独特的拓扑特征和潜在的超导行为而引起了人们的极大兴趣。在这项研究中，通过结合硼的 Py 和 Pz 轨道构建了紧束缚哈密顿量，有效地捕获了控制材料低能电子行为的基本物理原理。此外，首次使用扩散传输范围内的 Kubo-Greenwood 形式计算单层 h-B2O 的电子热导率 (ETC)。结果显示出很强的各向异性 ($$\:{\kappa\:}_{yy}\gg\:{\kappa\:}_{xx}$$)，室温 ETC 值为 $$\:5.9\times\:{10}^{-2}$$ mW m$$\:{}^{-1}$$ K$$\:{}^{-1}$$, 1 mW m$$\:{}^{-1}$$ K$$\:{}^{-1}$$ 和 0.17 mW m$$\:{}^{-1}$$ K$$\:{}^{-1}$$ 沿扶手椅 $$\:({\kappa\:}_{xx}$$)、之字形 $$\:({\kappa\:}_{yy}$$) 和分别为异常 Righi-Leduc 效应 $$\:({\kappa\:}_{xy}$$) 方向。此外，我们采用 T 矩阵近似系统地研究了 n 型和 p 型掺杂下杂质引起的紊乱对 h-B2O 中 ETC 的影响。在 n 型区域中，增加杂质浓度 $$\:{n}_{i}$$ = 2%、4%、6% 会导致与面外 Pz 轨道相关的 ETC 显着增强，这归因于其有利的空间取向和更高的载流子占有率。相反，由于局域化的增加和电子-电子散射的增强，面内 Py 轨道表现出 ETC 的减少。尽管存在这种轨道对比，总 ETC 沿所有晶体学方向上升，受 Pz 轨道的主导贡献控制，从而揭示了强烈的轨道分辨行为和明显的方向各向异性。相比之下，p 型掺杂仅引起适度的变化：Py 轨道的 ETC 贡献略有增加，而 Pz 轨道的 ETC 贡献略有减少，导致总 ETC 的整体响应较弱。这些发现强调了轨道对称性、空间取向和掺杂剂类型在塑造 h-B2O 的各向异性和可调热传输特性中的关键作用。 p 型掺杂下的热弹性以及 n 型掺杂下的方向依赖性增强，使 h-B2O 成为纳米级热电和热管理技术的有前途的候选者。

data.title: Synergistic and distinct effects of expansive posture and nasal breathing on psychological and physiological self-regulation in adolescents
data.author: Xiaoying Yang, Zixi Liu, Zhenting Li, Haosheng Ye, Feiyan Luo, Yang Wu
data.summary: Adolescents are vulnerable to anxiety and low self-efficacy due to heightened emotional reactivity and immature regulatory systems. Embodied interventions, such as posture adjustment and controlled breathing, have shown promise for enhancing psychological self-regulation, but their synergistic effects in adolescents remain unclear. This study examined the immediate and sustained effects of expansive posture, nasal breathing, and their combination on self-efficacy, anxiety, and autonomic nervous system (ANS) activity in adolescents aged 15–18 years. Participants completed the Trier Social Stress Test, received one of four interventions, and were assessed with self-report questionnaires (General Self-Efficacy Scale; State–Trait Anxiety Inventory-6; n = 138) and continuous electrodermal activity (EDA; n = 62) recorded during the intervention and a subsequent Stroop task. Results showed that expansive posture—alone or combined with nasal breathing—significantly increased self-efficacy, while all three active interventions reduced anxiety compared with controls. Physiological analyses revealed distinct patterns of ANS modulation: nasal breathing alone yielded more stable EDA profiles with lower variability—consistent with enhanced autonomic flexibility in HRV studies—while the combined intervention produced larger autonomic fluctuations, suggesting compensatory responses. These findings highlight the complementary benefits of posture and breathing strategies and support a phased “activate–then–stabilize” approach to adolescent self-regulation.
data.title_cn: 扩张姿势和鼻呼吸对青少年心理和生理自我调节的协同和独特影响
data.abstract_cn: 由于情绪反应加剧和监管系统不成熟，青少年容易焦虑和自我效能感低。姿势调整和控制呼吸等具体干预措施已显示出增强心理自我调节的希望，但它们对青少年的协同作用仍不清楚。本研究考察了扩张姿势、鼻呼吸及其组合对 15-18 岁青少年自我效能、焦虑和自主神经系统 (ANS) 活动的直接和持续影响。参与者完成了特里尔社会压力测试，接受四种干预措施之一，并通过自我报告问卷（一般自我效能量表；状态-特质焦虑量表-6；n = 138）和干预期间记录的持续皮电活动（EDA；n = 62）和随后的斯特鲁普任务进行评估。结果显示，与对照组相比，扩张姿势（单独或与鼻呼吸相结合）显着提高了自我效能，而所有三种主动干预措施都减少了焦虑。生理学分析揭示了 ANS 调节的不同模式：单独鼻呼吸产生更稳定的 EDA 曲线，且变异性更低——与 HRV 研究中增强的自主神经灵活性一致——而联合干预产生更大的自主波动，表明补偿反应。这些发现强调了姿势和呼吸策略的互补优势，并支持分阶段“激活-然后稳定”的青少年自我调节方法。

data.title: Gut microbiota and metabolic pathway profiles in infected and non-infected heart transplant patients before and after surgery
data.author: Jingxian Han, Lei Hua, Bin Yang, Siqi Zhang, Hui Qiao, Zibo Zhao, Long Chen, Xiangguang Meng, Zhiying Li
data.summary: The composition and metabolic characteristics of gut microbiota in heart transplant patients with and without preoperative and postoperative infection were investigated to elucidate the impact of antibiotics and immunosuppressants. Twenty patients undergoing allogeneic heart transplantation were enrolled. Gut microbiota profiles were analyzed via 16 S rRNA gene sequencing and metabolic pathway prediction (PICRUSt2) at 5–9 days preoperatively and 30 days postoperatively. Patients were categorized into preoperative non-infected (Pre-NI), preoperative infected (Pre-I), postoperative non-infected (Post-NI) and postoperative infected (Post-I) groups for comparative analysis. Alpha/beta diversity, Maaslin and functional analyses were performed. Preoperative microbiota had similar α-diversity indices and community structures among groups. Pre-NI microbiota were dominated by Bacteroides and Pre-I samples were enriched with Enterococcus casseliflavus、Limosilactobacillus and Weissella cibaria. Post-NI patients showed higher microbial diversity (Shannon/Simpson indices) and Blautia (butyrate-producer) whereas Post-I patients formed a distinct cluster with Enterococcus faecium dominance. Metabolic analysis highlighted Blautia-associated pathways, e.g., L-1,2-propanediol degradation. Dynamic preoperative shifts in the Bacteroides-Enterococcus-Limosilactobacillus axis and postoperative shifts toward Blautia-Enterococcus dominance were found in heart transplant patients and were associated with infection status and antibiotic exposure. Dual-target intervention with an emphasis on restoring butyrate-producing microbiota and monitoring Enterococcus dynamics is recommended to optimize personalized infection control systems in transplant patients.
data.title_cn: 感染和未感染心脏移植患者手术前后的肠道微生物群和代谢途径概况
data.abstract_cn: 研究了术前和术后感染和未感染的心脏移植患者肠道微生物群的组成和代谢特征，以阐明抗生素和免疫抑制剂的影响。纳入了 20 名接受同种异体心脏移植的患者。在术前 5-9 天和术后 30 天通过 16 S rRNA 基因测序和代谢途径预测 (PICRUSt2) 分析肠道微生物群概况。将患者分为术前非感染组（Pre-NI）、术前感染组（Pre-I）、术后非感染组（Post-NI）和术后感染组（Post-I）进行比较分析。进行了α/β多样性、Maaslin和功能分析。术前各组微生物群具有相似的α多样性指数和群落结构。 Pre-NI 微生物群以拟杆菌为主，Pre-I 样品富含肠球菌 cassseliflavus、Limosilactobacillus 和 Weissella cibaria。 NI 后患者表现出更高的微生物多样性（香农/辛普森指数）和 Blautia（丁酸盐生产者），而 I 后患者形成了一个以屎肠球菌为主的独特簇。代谢分析强调了 Blautia 相关途径，例如 L-1,2-丙二醇降解。在心脏移植患者中发现了拟杆菌-肠球菌-柠檬酸乳杆菌轴的术前动态转变和术后向布劳氏菌-肠球菌占优势的转变，并且与感染状态和抗生素暴露相关。建议采用双目标干预，重点是恢复产生丁酸的微生物群和监测肠球菌动态，以优化移植患者的个性化感染控制系统。

data.title: The spectral power distribution prediction of LED light source based on Gaussian mathematical model and improved residual network
data.author: Lihui Wu, Yang Li, Hongbin Chen, Jia Wang, Xuewei Wang, Yulu Xue
data.summary: Accurate prediction of the spectral power distribution of light-emitting diodes in multi-phosphor systems is challenging because of the influence of material composition and operating conditions. This paper proposes a spectral prediction framework that combines a Gaussian mathematical model with an improved residual neural network. First, light-emitting diode samples were fabricated using red and green phosphors, and their spectral power distributions were measured. The Gaussian model was then employed to extract the characteristic parameters from the continuous spectral power distributions, and these parameters were used to construct the corresponding dataset. Based on this dataset, a neural network framework was established to map the phosphor mixing ratio, phosphor-to-silicone ratio, and drive current to the Gaussian parameters. Through systematic comparative and extended validation experiments, it is demonstrated that the coefficient of determination for spectral power distribution reconstructed by the Gaussian mathematical model exceeds 0.99. The proposed improved residual network significantly outperforms baseline residual network and recent state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior predictive accuracy and stability. Furthermore, ablation studies validate the effectiveness of the attention mechanism, while sensitivity analyses and independent dataset evaluations further confirm the robustness and generalization capability of the proposed framework. The proposed model significantly enhances spectral prediction accuracy in multi-phosphor systems and achieves rapid mapping from material composition and electrical parameters to the resulting spectrum. A new modeling framework for customized light-emitting diode spectral design is provided in this study, and theoretical support is offered for the intelligent optimization of healthy-lighting and high-color-rendering light sources.
data.title_cn: 基于高斯数学模型和改进残差网络的LED光源光谱功率分布预测
data.abstract_cn: 由于材料成分和工作条件的影响，准确预测多荧光体系统中发光二极管的光谱功率分布具有挑战性。本文提出了一种将高斯数学模型与改进的残差神经网络相结合的光谱预测框架。首先，使用红色和绿色荧光粉制造发光二极管样品，并测量它们的光谱功率分布。然后采用高斯模型从连续光谱功率分布中提取特征参数，并使用这些参数构建相应的数据集。基于该数据集，建立了神经网络框架，将荧光粉混合比、荧光粉与硅树脂比和驱动电流映射到高斯参数。通过系统的对比和扩展验证实验，证明高斯数学模型重构的光谱功率分布的决定系数超过0.99。所提出的改进残差网络显着优于基线残差网络和最近最先进的方法，实现了卓越的预测准确性和稳定性。此外，消融研究验证了注意力机制的有效性，而敏感性分析和独立数据集评估进一步证实了所提出框架的鲁棒性和泛化能力。所提出的模型显着提高了多荧光粉系统中的光谱预测精度，并实现了从材料成分和电参数到最终光谱的快速映射。该研究为定制化发光二极管光谱设计提供了新的建模框架，为健康照明和高显色性光源的智能优化提供理论支持。

data.title: Mechanical and thermal performance of magnesium carbon fiber sandwich composites with variable fiber orientations for aerospace structures
data.author: M. E. Annadorai, M. Ramakrishna
data.summary: Sandwich composites are broadly recognised for their excellent stiffness, strength, and durability while minimising their weight. This study investigates the fabrication, mechanical testing, thermal analysis, and microstructural characterisation of magnesium-carbon fiber sandwich composites for aircraft applications. The composite panels were fabricated using traditional methods such as filament drum winding, followed by hand layup and compression moulding with six stacking sequences, including unidirectional ([0°], [45°], [90°]), bidirectional ([0°/90°], [45°/-45°]), and multidirectional ([0°/90°/45°/-45°]) fiber orientations. X-ray diffraction (XRD) investigated phase composition and crystalline structure. Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) revealed two-stage degradation, with [0°/90°]4 retaining the highest residue (73–75%), followed by the quasi-isotropic laminate (69–71%), while [90°]8 showed the lowest stability (51–53%). Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) confirmed decomposition onset between 250 °C and 380 °C, with balanced laminates exhibiting reduced endothermic peaks. Mechanical testing revealed strong orientation dependence, with the [0°]8 laminate exhibiting the highest tensile (223.8 MPa) and flexural strength (700.9 MPa), while the [90°]8 configuration showed the lowest values. Impact behaviour contrasted with tensile and flexural results, where the [45°/-45°]4 laminate absorbed the highest impact energy (0.42 kg·m; 101.43 kJ/m2). The quasi-isotropic stacking sequence Mg/CF[0°/90°/45°/-45°]2/Mg exhibited a well-balanced multifunctional response, attaining the third-highest tensile strength, second-highest flexural strength, and second-highest impact energy absorption among the evaluated laminates, while also demonstrating enhanced thermal stability as evidenced by higher TGA residual mass and more stable DSC transition behaviour. Microstructural analysis (SEM/EDS) revealed elemental composition and microstructural features, including fiber-matrix bonding, delamination, and fracture morphology. Results showed substantial differences in mechanical and thermal performance across fiber orientations, aiding in the design of magnesium-carbon fiber sandwich composites for lightweight, high-performance aerospace applications.
data.title_cn: 用于航空航天结构的可变纤维取向镁碳纤维夹层复合材料的机械和热性能
data.abstract_cn: 夹层复合材料因其出色的刚度、强度和耐用性而受到广泛认可，同时又最大限度地减轻了重量。本研究研究了用于飞机应用的镁碳纤维夹层复合材料的制造、机械测试、热分析和微观结构表征。复合材料板采用传统方法制造，例如纤维滚筒缠绕，然后采用六种堆叠顺序进行手工铺层和压缩成型，包括单向（[0°]、[45°]、[90°]）、双向（[0°/90°]、[45°/-45°]）和多向（[0°/90°/45°/-45°]）纤维方向。 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 研究了相组成和晶体结构。热重分析 (TGA) 显示两阶段降解，[0°/90°]4 保留最高残留物 (73–75%)，其次是准各向同性层压板 (69–71%)，而 [90°]8 显示最低稳定性 (51–53%)。差示扫描量热法 (DSC) 证实分解在 250 °C 至 380 °C 之间开始，平衡层压板表现出吸热峰减少。机械测试显示出强烈的取向依赖性，[0°]8层压板表现出最高的拉伸强度（223.8 MPa）和弯曲强度（700.9 MPa），而[90°]8配置显示出最低值。冲击行为与拉伸和弯曲结果形成对比，其中 [45°/-45°]4 层压板吸收了最高的冲击能量（0.42 kg·m；101.43 kJ/m2）。准各向同性堆叠序列 Mg/CF[0°/90°/45°/-45°]2/Mg 表现出均衡的多功能响应，在所评估的层压板中获得第三高的拉伸强度、第二高的弯曲强度和第二高的冲击能量吸收，同时还表现出增强的热稳定性，如更高的 TGA 残余质量和更稳定的 DSC 转变行为所证明。微观结构分析 (SEM/EDS) 揭示了元素组成和微观结构特征，包括纤维基体粘合、分层和断裂形态。结果显示，不同纤维方向的机械和热性能存在显着差异，有助于设计用于轻质、高性能航空航天应用的镁碳纤维夹层复合材料。

data.title: Experimental and computational study of photocatalytic degradation of volatile organic compounds in bitumen using sulfur-doped phenol-rich bio-oils
data.author: Mohammad Almasi, Razieh Sadat Neyband
data.summary: Asphalt pavements are a significant source of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) emissions under solar radiation, accelerated asphalt aging and urban air pollution. Effective mechanisms are essential to reduce the environmental and health impacts of road infrastructure. In this study, a sustainable bio-based modification strategy is presented using sulfur-doped phenol-rich bio-oils derived from wood pellets (WPn) to suppress VOCs release from asphalt. In this process, tetrameric radical sulfur ($$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}$$) reacts with the WPn to generate $$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}$$-WPn intermediates that capture VOCs molecules through a C–S cross-coupling pathway, forming stable VOCs-$$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}$$-WPn adducts. The mechanism was validated experimentally using GC–MS, FT–IR, and UV–Vis spectroscopy, and supported by TD–DFT computational analysis. The UV–Vis absorption spectral of $$\:\:\text{V}\text{O}\text{C}\text{s}-{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}-\text{W}\text{P}\text{n}$$ has been red-shifted to nearly 400 nm which potentially enhanced the ability of these VOCs compounds to absorb light at wavelength higher than 200 nm, thereby favoring the direct photodegradation of VOCs compounds. Also, the calculated activation energy barriers for the $$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}-\text{W}\text{P}\text{n}$$ and VOCs reaction pathways were found to range between − 5.62 and − 25.86 kcal/mol, confirming the thermodynamic feasibility and suppression potential of VOCs emissions. This work highlights a practical and environmentally friendly approach for the development of cleaner and more resilient urban infrastructure.
data.title_cn: 使用掺硫富酚生物油光催化降解沥青中挥发性有机化合物的实验和计算研究
data.abstract_cn: 沥青路面是太阳辐射、加速沥青老化和城市空气污染下挥发性有机化合物 (VOC) 排放的重要来源。有效的机制对于减少道路基础设施对环境和健康的影响至关重要。在这项研究中，提出了一种可持续的生物基改性策略，使用源自木颗粒（WPn）的掺硫富含酚的生物油来抑制沥青中挥发性有机化合物的释放。在此过程中，四聚自由基硫($$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}$$)与WPn反应生成$$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}$$-WPn中间体，通过C-S交叉偶联途径捕获VOCs分子，形成稳定的VOCs-$$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}$$-WPn加合物。该机制通过 GC-MS、FT-IR 和 UV-Vis 光谱进行实验验证，并得到 TD-DFT 计算分析的支持。 $$\:\:\text{V}\text{O}\text{C}\text{s}-{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}-\text{W}\text{P}\text{n}$$ 的紫外-可见吸收光谱已红移至近 400 nm，这可能增强了这些 VOC 化合物吸收波长高于 200 nm 的光的能力，从而有利于直接光降解VOC 化合物。此外，计算得出的 $$\:{S}_{4}^{\cdot\:}-\text{W}\text{P}\text{n}$$ 和 VOC 反应路径的活化能垒范围在 − 5.62 至 − 25.86 kcal/mol 之间，证实了 VOC 排放的热力学可行性和抑制潜力。这项工作强调了一种实用且环保的方法，用于开发更清洁、更具弹性的城市基础设施。
